acceptanceCriteria: The behavior-adapter guide states the placement rule (or the request accepts a declared documentation repository for review inventories, decided explicitly).
The guide shows a minimal valid migration identity record and the self-reference pitfall, checked by a doc example test or fixture.
body: The guide does not say that input anchors must live in the source (e2e) repository (separate notes/docs repos are refused with 'supply immutable Git identities from the provider repository'), and does not show the minimal schema-2 migration record (schema, contract_id, source_revision, documentation_revision, revisions) or warn about self-referencing revisions committed in the same commit they name. Source: beamfall/corvint#717.
title: docs corpus guide: document input-anchor placement rule and the minimal schema-2 migration identity record
